This Privacy Policy describes how Habit Tracker ("we", "our", or "us") collects, uses, stores, and protects your personal information when you use our mobile application.\n
By using the Application, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with the terms of this Policy, please do not use the Application.

We collect the following types of information:

• Account Information: email address, name, profile photo (optional)
 • Device Information: device model, operating system version, unique device identifiers
 • Usage Data: information about how you use the Application, including your habits, completion history, and app interactions
 • Firebase Cloud Messaging Token: for sending push notifications
 • Analytics Data: anonymous usage statistics to improve the Application

We do not collect your precise geolocation data.

We use your personal information for the following purposes:

• To provide and maintain the Application functionality
 • To synchronize your data across devices
 • To send you push notifications about your habits and friend activities
 • To improve and personalize your experience
 • To communicate with you about updates and support
 • To ensure security and prevent fraud

Your data is stored securely using:

• Firebase Firestore (Google) for cloud data synchronization
 • Firebase Authentication for secure account management
 • Local encryption on your device
 • Secure data transmission via HTTPS/SSL

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your data only with:

• Service Providers: Google Firebase (hosting, authentication, analytics)
 • Legal Requirements: when required by law or to protect our rights
 • With Your Consent: when you explicitly agree to share

Your habit data is shared only with participants of your group habits as intended by the Application functionality.

Under applicable data protection laws, you have the right to:

• Access your personal data
 • Correct inaccurate or incomplete data
 • Delete your account and associated data
 • Export your data
 • Withdraw consent for data processing

To exercise these rights, contact us at: racerkafa@yandex.ru

The Application is not intended for use by children under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 16. If you become aware that a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us immediately.

We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.
You are advised to review this Privacy Policy periodically for any changes.

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us:
Email: racerkafa@yandex.ru
We will respond to your inquiry within 30 days.
